rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose attributive term for something belonging to or relating to reptiles.

example.english: This is a reptilian skeleton diagram.
example.traditional: 呢幅係爬蟲類嘅骨骼圖。
example.jyutping: ne1 fuk1 hai6 paa4 cung4 leoi6 ge3 gwat1 gaak3 tou4

rows.note: Use this when something resembles a reptile in appearance or qualities rather than actually belonging to the reptile class.

example.english: Their face looks reptilian and cold.
example.traditional: 佢塊面似爬蟲類嘅，望落去冷冰冰咁。
example.jyutping: keoi5 faai3 min6 ci5 paa4 cung4 leoi6 ge3 mong6 lok6 heoi3 laang5 bing1 bing1 gam3
